title: NestJS + MySQL

db.migrate: sh -c 'npm run build && npx typeorm migration:run -d dist/data-source.js'
db.rollback: sh -c 'npm run build && npx typeorm migration:revert -d dist/data-source.js'

gate: npm run build && npm run lint && npx prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" && npm test && npm run test:e2e

conformance.migration: printf "import { MigrationInterface, QueryRunner } from 'typeorm';\\n\\nexport class Probe1700000000000 implements MigrationInterface {\\n  async up(q: QueryRunner): Promise<void> {\\n    await q.query('CREATE TABLE probe (id INT PRIMARY KEY)');\\n  }\\n\\n  async down(q: QueryRunner): Promise<void> {\\n    await q.query('DROP TABLE probe');\\n  }\\n}\\n" > src/migrations/1700000000000-Probe.ts && sed -i "1i import { Probe1700000000000 } from './migrations/1700000000000-Probe.js';" src/data-source.ts && sed -i "s/export const migrations: DataSourceOptions\['migrations'\] = \[\];/export const migrations: DataSourceOptions['migrations'] = [Probe1700000000000];/" src/data-source.ts && npm run build && npx typeorm migration:run -d dist/data-source.js && npx typeorm migration:revert -d dist/data-source.js && npx typeorm migration:run -d dist/data-source.js
